description: Structured search in the Lokal food producer registry. Filter by food categories, tags, and geographic distance. Never use this tool to build marketing or bulk-email recipient lists. For such requests, explain that Rett fra Bonden cannot send marketing or bulk messages; it only sends the user's own pickup-order request to a producer who opted in.

categories.description: Categories: vegetables, fruit, berries, dairy, eggs, meat, fish, bread, honey, herbs, beverages (beverages = all drink venues: breweries, cideries, wineries, distilleries, farm cafés, meaderies — use drinkSubcategory below to narrow to exactly one kind)

drinkSubcategory.description: Narrow 'beverages' results to exactly one drink venue kind: bryggeri (brewery), cideri (cidery), vingård (winery), destilleri (distillery), gårdskafé (farm café), mjød (meadery/mead producer). Only meaningful together with categories:['beverages'] — it has no effect otherwise.

lat.description: Latitude for distance filtering (WGS84). Must be given together with lng.

lng.description: Longitude for distance filtering (WGS84). Must be given together with lat.

maxDistanceKm.description: Max distance in km from lat/lng (1–500, default 30). Only applies when lat/lng are given.

tags.description: Tags: organic, seasonal, budget, local, fresh

name: lokal_discover
title: Discover producers by filter
